title: Cabin Sensor Telemetry
description: Real sensor history from cabin_event -- Zigbee temp/humidity/water-leak (native fields) and Kidde CO/CO2/temperature/humidity (HomeAssistantDiscoveryService's sensor-domain value capture, added 2026-08-25). Queries the live hot-tier table directly; once a month is archived (TelemetryArchivalService) it drops out of these panels -- see docs/MAINTENANCE.md.

panels.description: Zigbee temperature sensors (kitchen, mech room, outside).

targets.rawSql: SELECT time AS "time", device_id AS metric, (payload->>'temperature')::numeric AS value FROM cabin_event WHERE event_type = 'TELEMETRY' AND payload ? 'temperature' AND $__timeFilter(time) ORDER BY time

panels.title: Zigbee Temperature

targets.rawSql: SELECT time AS "time", device_id AS metric, (payload->>'humidity')::numeric AS value FROM cabin_event WHERE event_type = 'TELEMETRY' AND payload ? 'humidity' AND $__timeFilter(time) ORDER BY time

panels.description: true = leak detected. Real, not a fixed threshold guess.

targets.rawSql: SELECT time AS "time", device_id AS metric, CASE WHEN payload->>'water_leak' = 'true' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS value FROM cabin_event WHERE event_type = 'TELEMETRY' AND payload ? 'water_leak' AND $__timeFilter(time) ORDER BY time

panels.title: Water Leak State

panels.description: Kidde CO/air-quality unit, indoor temperature. Populates once the sensor-domain value-capture fix (2026-08-25) is deployed and HA has polled at least twice.

targets.rawSql: SELECT time AS "time", payload->>'friendly_name' AS metric, (payload->>'value')::numeric AS value FROM cabin_event WHERE event_type = 'TELEMETRY' AND device_id ILIKE '%kidde%' AND payload->>'device_class' = 'temperature' AND payload->>'value' ~ '^-?[0-9]+\.?[0-9]*$' AND $__timeFilter(time) ORDER BY time

panels.title: Kidde Temperature

panels.description: Kidde CO/air-quality unit, humidity. Populates once the sensor-domain value-capture fix (2026-08-25) is deployed and HA has polled at least twice.

targets.rawSql: SELECT time AS "time", payload->>'friendly_name' AS metric, (payload->>'value')::numeric AS value FROM cabin_event WHERE event_type = 'TELEMETRY' AND device_id ILIKE '%kidde%' AND payload->>'device_class' = 'humidity' AND payload->>'value' ~ '^-?[0-9]+\.?[0-9]*$' AND $__timeFilter(time) ORDER BY time

panels.title: Kidde Humidity

panels.description: Kidde CO2 sensor (ppm). Populates once the sensor-domain value-capture fix (2026-08-25) is deployed and HA has polled at least twice. Kidde's dedicated CO-level entity has no device_class set on the live account (a HA-side gap, not something faked here) -- included by device_id match instead.

targets.rawSql: SELECT time AS "time", payload->>'friendly_name' AS metric, (payload->>'value')::numeric AS value FROM cabin_event WHERE event_type = 'TELEMETRY' AND device_id ILIKE '%kidde%' AND (payload->>'device_class' = 'carbon_dioxide' OR device_id ILIKE '%co-level%') AND payload->>'value' ~ '^-?[0-9]+\.?[0-9]*$' AND $__timeFilter(time) ORDER BY time

panels.title: Kidde CO / CO2
